verdict.rationale: Greptile is a SaaS code-review platform that uses API keys, so an interactive API reference is a fair question to ask. The evidence pack contains no documented interactive API reference or runnable API examples, and probes for OpenAPI/Swagger specs all returned 404. The CLI, MCP server and llms.txt/markdown docs are adjacent features and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
